name: checker_emits_hold
why: A checker can hold its OWN watermark by returning outcome=hold (github_pr and jira do this on a saturated or tie-boundary page, added in B1). The shell only recognized clean/dirty/ratelimited/error/misconfig, so outcome=hold hit the 'unknown outcome' path and was mismapped to error -> backoff -> eventually misconfig — a latent live bug from B1, surfaced while porting the analyze phase to tick_check.py. Correct behaviour: the watch HOLDS (watermark unmoved, no dispatch), exactly like the derived saturation hold.
